text:
Taylor: Quick thread — we need a compact benchmark one-pager for the webinar + an inbound lead path. Objective: one hero, 3 charts, 2 CTAs, and a short appendix for ops.

Imran: My proposed hero: "Predictable latency. Measurable token economics." Subtitle: "Three charts that map config choices to latency & $/1k tokens."

Chloe: Charts: 1) compact latency panel (median/p95/p99) comparing hosted/dedicated/private; 2) $/1k waterfall (model  infra  optimizations); 3) persona table (Startup/Scale/Enterprise): p95 target + expected $/1k. Keep captions <= 10 words.

Ben: Data ask: CSV headers = model,deployment,quant,seq_bucket,median_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cost_per_1k_usd,cache_hit_rate,batch_profile. Prompt mix: 65/25/10 short/med/long. Include cache vs no-cache rows. Export target: s3://bench-exports/2026/marketing/5332123456.csv (will populate).

Taylor: Timeline: hero + 2 alt lines by Tue noon; Ben CSV Wed 10am; Chloe mockups Wed 3pm. I'll assemble Thu morning and circulate.

Ben: Quick reproducibility snippet for notes:
```
# estimate per-1k token cost
sec_per_1k = 0.78
gpu_rate = 2.6  # $/gpu-hour
cost = (sec_per_1k / 3600) * gpu_rate
print(cost)
```

Imran: Hero alternates: 
- A: "Serve fast. Know your spend."
- B: "Latency SLAs you can promise; economics you can trust."
Use A for social, B for deck.

Chloe: Visual note: show cache impact as an inset (example: 0/30/60% hit rates) and annotate batching gains. Colors: use brand accent for optimization bars.

OpsBot: Schema check scheduled. Will ping if mismatches.

Taylor: For the 1-pager CTAs: 1) "Run your prompts  See your numbers" 2) "Request a Dedicated eval  Talk to solutions." Also capture inbound routing: trial leads -> PSQL tag = "bench-webinar-5332123456".

Ben: Uploaded sample preview link (internal): https://internal.redwood/bench/5332123456 (private).

Taylor: Thanks team. If blockers, flag here. Check-in Wed AM. :rocket:
